title: Three Courtesies
summary: Takemura takes you to a rooftop tea garden in Japantown, where an old tea host tests you on three courtesies and asks for a haiku.

start.bringUp: Takemura proposes a tea garden above a shop in Japantown, to see whether you can be taught three courtesies.

spot.name: the rooftop tea garden above a shop in Japantown

g1.know: The tea host has asked V for a haiku in a gesture, and Takemura is waiting to score it.
g1.secret: He has written exactly one haiku in his life.

variations.know: It is night and the garden is lit with paper lanterns.
A second guest is at the table, and does every courtesy wrong.
V is hosting this time, and Takemura is the student.
variations.wants: V to teach him one courtesy.

stages.label: V and Takemura take tea with the host on the roof
stages.know: You are at the rooftop tea garden with Takemura and an old tea host. She tests three moments: arriving, receiving the cup and leaving.
stages.wants: V to pass the three courtesies.

done.memory: You took Takemura to a Japantown rooftop tea garden, and the old host tested you on three courtesies.

stood-up.memory: You did not come to the tea garden, and Takemura waited for you above the shop.
